_comment: Sourced from research R2 (docs/research/findings-all.md). Savings for bill fixes are computed from the bill; saving_low/high are % of the end-use's kWh.

rows.quoted_line: Cost of a100 kvar capacitor bank with APFC with a rate of Rs. 15000 – 20000. / The expected monetary savings to be achieved by installation of kVAr compensator is INR 1.1 lakhs, with an investment of INR 1.2 lakhs, and a payback period of 13 months.
rows.saving_note: Payback uses the TGSPDCL saving on your bill, not the sources' Punjab PF-rebate paybacks.
rows.source: Saving computed from the bill at runtime (Doc 03). rows.cost_note: 2020 price per 500 kg furnace (13.5 t/day); get a current quote
rows.enduse_share_note: Induction furnace share of site electricity, Technology Compendium - Belgaum Foundry Cluster (UNIDO/BEE/CII, Sept 2020) p.40: "In such foundry units, induction furnace is the major electricity consuming equipment; it consumes about 70-85% of total electrical energy consumption."
rows.saving_note: 8.2% cut in furnace kWh per tonne, computed from the source's SEC 656 -> 602.1 kWh/t. Applies only if you melt in an SCR induction furnace.
rows.equipment: Replace SCR induction furnace with IGBT furnace
rows.source: Technology Compendium - Belgaum Foundry Cluster (UNIDO/BEE/CII, Sept 2020)

rows.quoted_line: Every 3% slag would consume 6% additional power
rows.saving_note: Saving not quantified for your unit. Source: every 3% slag adds 6% power; every 70 °C overheating costs 27 kWh/t.
rows.equipment: Clean the charge and control tapping temperature
rows.source: Technology Compendium - Belgaum Foundry Cluster (UNIDO/BEE/CII, Sept 2020)

rows.quoted_line: Reduction in set pressure and arresting leakages gives energy savings of up to 10-15% from the present consumption.
rows.cost_note: 2020 prices, 206 cfm at 7 bar (high includes air dryer); get a current quote
rows.saving_note: Saving pending: needs compressor energy measurement (10-15% is of the compressor's own use).
rows.equipment: Screw compressor with ring main and receiver, lower set pressure
rows.source: Technology Compendium - Belgaum Foundry Cluster (UNIDO/BEE/CII, Sept 2020)

rows.quoted_line: Typical energy savings by installing VFD in a screw compressor will be in the range of 25% to 85%, based on the unloading percentage and unloading power.
rows.cost_note: 2020 price, one screw compressor (case study); get a current quote
rows.saving_note: Saving pending: needs compressor energy measurement (25-85% is of the compressor's own use).
rows.equipment: VFD with pressure control on the screw compressor
rows.source: Technology Compendium - Belgaum Foundry Cluster (UNIDO/BEE/CII, Sept 2020)
